exams.name: Written examination for adjuster license
exams.notes: Exempt if applicant has been a full-time salaried employee of an insurer or managing general agent for one year; also exempt if nonresident adjuster duly licensed in another state and deemed fully qualified by the commissioner.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the commissioner)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license or an individual applying for an adjuster, including crop adjuster, license shall pass a written examination unless exempt under this section or RCW 48.17.175.

required.quote: The commissioner may by rule establish minimum continuing education requirements for the renewal or reissuance of a license to a crop adjuster, an independent adjuster, and a public adjuster.

available.quote: applicants for a license as a nonresident adjuster who are duly licensed in another state and who are deemed by the commissioner to be fully qualified and competent for a similar license in this state

requirements.value: Nonresident adjusters duly licensed in another state and deemed by the commissioner to be fully qualified and competent are exempt from the examination requirement. bonding_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as public adjuster, the applicant therefor shall file with the commissioner and shall thereafter maintain in force while so licensed a surety bond in favor of the people of the state of Washington, executed by an authorized corporate surety approved by the commissioner, in the amount of five thousand dollars.

definition_quote.value: "Public adjuster" means an adjuster employed by and representing solely the financial interests of the insured named in the policy.
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjuster" means an adjuster employed by and representing solely the financial interests of the insured named in the policy.

value: investigate and negotiate settlement relative to insurance claims
apply the factual circumstances of an insurance claim to the insurance policy provisions
methods_authorized.quote: An adjuster shall have authority under an adjuster's license only to either investigate and negotiate settlement relative to insurance claims, or apply the factual circumstances of an insurance claim to the insurance policy provisions, or both, to the adjuster's principal upon claims as limited under RCW 48.17.010(1) on behalf only of insureds if licensed as a public adjuster.

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: The commissioner licenses as an adjuster only an individual or business entity which has otherwise complied with this code

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: If a nonresident business entity, has designated an individual licensed adjuster responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and rules of this state.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: A nonresident person holding an adjuster's license or equivalent in a state other than Washington that is the applicant's home state, or is designated as the applicant's home state, must comply with the requirements of this section

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: each resident applicant, and nonresident applicant designating Washington as the applicant's home state must furnish information concerning his or her identity, including fingerprints for submission to the Washington state patrol, the federal bureau of investigation, and any governmental agency or entity authorized to receive this information for a state and national criminal history background check

surety_bond_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as public adjuster, the applicant therefor shall file with the commissioner and shall thereafter maintain in force while so licensed a surety bond in favor of the people of the state of Washington, executed by an authorized corporate surety approved by the commissioner, in the amount of five thousand dollars.

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: in the amount of five thousand dollars

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: Assess a civil penalty of not more than twenty-five thousand dollars for each violation, after providing notice and an opportunity for a hearing in accordance with chapters 34.05 and 48.04 RCW.
